js: document.querySelector('[data-testid=cockpit] nav button[aria-label="Giám sát cabin"]').click();await __sleep(1500);const L=[];const w=document.createTreeWalker(document.querySelector('[data-testid=cockpit]'),NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);let n;while(n=w.nextNode()){const t=n.textContent.trim();if(!t)continue;const e=n.parentElement;if(e.closest('.maplibregl-ctrl-attrib,canvas,[aria-hidden=true]'))continue;const cs=getComputedStyle(e);if(cs.visibility==='hidden'||cs.display==='none')continue;let op=1,p=e;while(p&&p!==document.body){op*=+getComputedStyle(p).opacity;p=p.parentElement}const rg=document.createRange();rg.selectNodeContents(n);const r=rg.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.width<2||r.height<2||r.bottom<0||r.right<0||r.x>innerWidth||r.y>innerHeight)continue;L.push({t:t.slice(0,26),c:cs.color,fs:cs.fontSize,op:+op.toFixed(2),r:[Math.round(r.x),Math.round(r.y),Math.round(r.width),Math.round(r.height)]})}return JSON.stringify(L)
